title: Table contract judgment (E3b, experiment branch)
description: The judgment half of a describe or amend proposal: what the model declares over a machine half that code writes from the profile (describe) or the committed contract (amend). docs/experiments/e3/KEY.md. A structured-outputs-compatible projection (F-26): flat, every property required, every enum typed, no composition keywords.

stance.description: The stance of this run; must equal the skeleton's.

column_prose.description: Describe: one entry per profiled column, by its exact name, carrying the reviewer-facing description and the evidence quoted. Amend: empty; descriptions move only by a description_change.

description.description: One or two reviewer-facing sentences saying what the column is.

rationale.description: The profile numbers relied on: null_rate, distinct_count, min, max, samples.

added_columns.description: Amend only: the full definition of every add_column change; enters optional (F-28). Empty under describe.

physical_type.description: The DuckDB type; for a drift-add, the type the fresh profile measures.

required.description: Always false: additions enter optional and tighten in a later amendment (F-28).

grain_keys.description: Describe: the smallest set of column names that plausibly identifies one row. Amend: the committed grain, or the grain after a declared grain_change.

quality_rules.description: Describe: the column-level rules the evidence supports; code writes row_count_positive and grain_unique. Amend: the definition of every rule a rule_change adds.

rationale.description: The profile numbers that justify the rule.

changes.description: Amend: every difference between the committed contract and the contract proposed, one entry per change, nothing undeclared. Empty under describe.

column.description: The column changed; empty for grain_change, rule_change, and no_change.

before.description: The committed value as the amend prompt defines it per kind.

after.description: The proposed value as the amend prompt defines it per kind.

decisions.description: The judgments a reviewer must see: camelCase keys starting with decision, kebab-case values, evidence in the rationale.

purpose.description: What the table is and what it holds (describe); amend may restate it or leave it empty to keep the committed text.

usage.description: How to read the table at its grain; amend as above.

limitations.description: What the profile could not settle; amend as above.
